AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Provides read-only Windows laptop status and process search, and opens Laptop Status screens on user request. Joke mode is never activated by an AppFunction; it only opens the app's explicit confirmation dialog. Power and Joke Mode requests only open an explicit confirmation in the app; they do not send commands directly. No screen input or process termination functions are exposed. Configure and pair the laptop in the app before using remote status or process search.
AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:displayDescription: Pantau laptop Windows dan cari proses dari Gemini.
